in_sanskrit.name: Vikasith
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Progress, growth, development
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vikasith एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Vikasith is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'Vikas' meaning progress, growth, development and 'Iti' meaning that, this. This name signifies the one who brings progress, growth, and development to his surroundings and is dedicated to the path of wisdom, courage, and strength. It is an apt name for a child who is destined to make a significant impact in the world.
